. * Claims for exemption from the requirement that the annual report be covered by the opinion of an independent public accountant must
be supported by a statement of facts and circumstances relied on as the basis for the exemption. See Section 240.17a-5(e)(2)

Potential persons who are to respond to the collection of information
SEC 1410 (06-02) contained in this form are not required to respond unless the form
displays a currently valid OMB control number.

OATH OR AFFIRMATION

I, Michael Bleich , swear (or affirm) that, to the best of my knowledge and belief the accompanying financial
statement and supporting schedules pertaining to the firm of Scout Trading, LLC , as of
December 31, 2009, are true and correct. I further swear (or affirm) that neither the company nor any partner,
proprietor, principal officer or director has any proprietary interest in any account classified solely as that of a
customer, except as follows: NONE.
